title: Vizipedia lets agents build and revise interactive explanations
friendlyTitle: Vizipedia uses AI agents to make interactive lessons
summary: Vizipedia is a small open-source visual encyclopedia whose interactive pages are edited through code by AI agents, with every version retained. Its initial collection explains topics including transformer attention, Git storage and recommendation systems.
friendlySummary: The site offers visual explanations that AI coding agents can update, while keeping a record of every version.
whyItMatters: It is an interesting test of agents as maintainers of interactive learning material rather than just text generators. The visible version history also gives readers a way to inspect how explanations change.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Interactive examples can make difficult ideas easier to learn, and the history makes changes easier to check.
